newsitem.title: USA: North Face files for 2.5 mln shr offering.
newsitem.headline: North Face files for 2.5 mln shr offering.

text.p: North Face Inc said Monday it registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2.5 million common shares.

Of the total, one million will be sold by the company and 1.5 million will be offered by certain selling shareholders, the filing said. After the offering, the company will have 11,188,594 common shares outstanding.

The stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option of up to 375,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Alex. Brown & Sons Inc, Hambrecht & Quist and J.P. Morgan & Co.
Net proceeds will be used for repayment of debt, including debt held by affiliated stockholders, the filing said.
The San Leandro, Calif., company designs and distributes outerwear, skiwear, functional sportswear, tents, sleeping bags and backpacks.
